votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2021-22
votes.description: Closes the public hearing held to accept comment on the proposed amendment to the RDA's FY2021-22 budget, which includes funding for Ballpark development, an ADU pilot program, and transfer of the Housing Trust Fund to the RDA.
Approves the official meeting minutes of the RDA Board of Directors from the March 8, 2022 meeting.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 3 of 2022 (RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2021-22) as proposed
votes.description: Adopts the resolution amending the RDA's final budget for FY2021-22, including funding for Ballpark area development, an ADU pilot program in the 9-Line project area, and transfer of the Housing Trust Fund to the RDA.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 4 of 2022 identifying the Housing Funding Priorities for Fiscal Year 2022-2023
votes.description: Adopts the resolution establishing the RDA's Affordable Housing Funding Priorities for FY2022-23, which guide housing activities including requirements for the competitive affordable housing notice of funding availability (NOFA).

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda (Set Date – Resolution: Budget for the RDA for Fiscal Year 2022-23)
votes.description: Sets May 17, 2022 and June 7, 2022 as the dates to accept public comment and consider adopting the final RDA budget for FY2022-23.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137
votes.description: Authorizes the Board to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters.
Formally ends the closed session and returns the Board to open meeting.
